 ET Online | 26 Oct 2026, 10:46 AM IST External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar highlighted a growing “4F crisis” confronting the Global South, pointing to challenges linked to food, fuel, fertilisers and finance. He stressed the need for greater resilience and cooperation among developing nations to address these global pressures.
